Strategy: Apply the sweet band only to large items, rewarding leftovers between thirty and forty-five when the item is at least sixty; smaller items use Best Fit. Large items leave more meaningful leftovers. It may help by targeting the band where it matters, but may fail if large items are rare.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (20 if item >= 60 and r - item >= 30 and r - item <= 45 else 0) for r in bins]
```
